thread:
maria: Heads-up — after the calico 3.29.0 rollout to west3 this morning I'm seeing big east-west latency spikes for GPU training pods. Throughput drops, jobs stuck in backoff.

aj: saw the alert. pod-pod RTT went from ~0.6ms to 8-30ms on avg, and packet retransmits are jumping. qdisc shows weird fragmentation.

ben: deploy-bot shows the calico rollout finished at 08:42 UTC. any chance the tunnel MTU changed? we still have SR-IOV and GENEVE mix on that cluster.

maria: that's my hunch. I checked one node: ifconfig shows geneve0 MTU=1450 but host links are 9000. some pods have host-device SR-IOV iface with mtu 9000 -> mismatch.

sophie: that would trigger GRO/GSO mismatches and cause excessive reassembly + reorder. can you grab tcpdump?

maria: tcpdump from pod -> node shows lots of duplicate ACKs and out-of-order. snippet:

```
16:12:05.123456 IP podA > podB: Flags [.], seq 1:1401, ack 1, win 4096, length 1400
16:12:05.123789 IP podA > podB: Flags [.], seq 1:2801, ack 1, win 4096, length 1400
16:12:05.124000 IP podA > podB: Flags [.], seq 2801:4201, ack 1, win 4096, length 1400 (out-of-order)
```

aj: interesting — calico's new tunnel fragmentation code might enable small-MTU path detection, but it should have preserved pod MTU. maybe kubelet CNI args got dropped on restart.

ben: checking kubelet logs on a repro node: saw calico restart and a warning about "failed to set routes for workload endpoints: mtu set to host mtu" at 08:41:51.

maria: yep: logs:
```
I0811 08:41:51.987623 1 ipam.go:234] setting workload endpoint mtu to 9000
W0811 08:41:51.987655 1 endpoint.go:512] endpoint vxlan config differs, forcing host MTU
```

sophie: forcing host MTU -> pod iface at 9000 while geneve uses 1450 for overlay, that can cause envelope fragmentation and reordering. we need temporary mitigation: pin calico to previous revision on west3 or flip policy to use host-gw for affected nodes.

oncall-bot: Incident ticket created: INF-2438 — "west3 calico upgrade -> east-west packet reordering for GPU pods" (priority P1)

aj: rolling back calico to 3.28.4 on west3 now (canary first). I'll cordon a couple of nodes and drain one canary GPU node to validate.

maria: also adding a short-term iptables rule to disable GRO on interfaces showing reordering to reduce out-of-order grouping: `ethtool -K eth0 gro off` on affected nodes. not ideal but stabilizes for now.

ben: confirmed: after GRO off on one node, seen RTT back to ~0.8ms and retransmits dropped 90%. good quick test.

sophie: follow-ups: 1) audit calico release notes for overlay MTU logic; 2) add node labeling to prevent automated calico upgrades on mixed SR-IOV clusters; 3) add MTU convergence check in preflight for upgrades.

maria: creating a runbook section in INF-2438 with exact steps we used. will also put a note in deploy playbook to hold calico upgrades unless MTU parity is validated.

aj: rollback finished to canary group, monitoring. will expand if stable. thanks everyone. :thumbsup:

maria: filing a short RCA draft later today — initial cause: calico 3.29 speculative host-MTU forcing + mixed SR-IOV/Geneve configs leading to packet fragmentation/reassembly mismatch -> increased latency and GPU job SLO violations.

sophie: cc @platform-team for adding MTU checks to the upgrade job.

oncall-bot: INF-2438 updated: status -> "mitigated (rollback)" — assigned to maria for RCA.
